d:
The tennis lasts a week. But what stays with Turin when the players and fans go home?
Qasa Alom heads into the city to explore Nitto’s contribution beyond the court, from neighbourhood tree planting to the Green Art Wall shaped by children supported by Casa UGI.
He also meets Nitto’s Kenshi Tozuka to hear why the Torino Green Project was created, and UGI President Professor Enrico Pira to discover the story behind the children’s involvement.
The final episode of Beyond The Serve, our series meeting the people helping the Finals make a positive difference to people and the planet.
